# `csharp_space_before_colon_in_inheritance_clause`

Space before the colon in a base list.

## Values

| Value | Notes |
|---|---|
| `true` |  |
| `false` |  |

**Default:** `true`

## Example

::::{tab-set}

:::{tab-item} Before
```csharp
namespace N;

public interface IWidget { }

public class Widget: IWidget
{
    public void Run() { }
}
```
:::

:::{tab-item} After
```csharp
namespace N;

public interface IWidget { }

public class Widget : IWidget
{
    public void Run() { }
}
```
:::

::::

### `csharp_space_before_colon_in_inheritance_clause = false`

```ini
csharp_space_before_colon_in_inheritance_clause = false
```

```csharp
namespace N;

public interface IWidget { }

public class Widget: IWidget
{
    public void Run() { }
}
```
